{"id":2053417403,"question_id":8,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 weeks","timestamp":1782989472,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2053417403/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"String to Integer (atoi)","memory":"9.1 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n\n    int CheckAllConditions(string &s)\n    {\n        int i = 0;\n        int n = s.size();\n\n        ll number_formed = 0;\n        int sign = 1;\n        \n        while(i < n and s[i] == ' ') i++;\n\n        if(i == n) return 0;\n\n        if(s[i] == '-' or s[i] == '+')\n        {\n            sign = (s[i] == '-') ? -1 : +1;\n            i++;\n        }\n\n        while(i < n and isdigit(s[i])) \n        {\n            number_formed = number_formed * 10 + (s[i] - '0');\n\n            if(sign == 1 and number_formed > INT_MAX) return INT_MAX;\n            if(sign == -1 and -number_formed < INT_MIN) return INT_MIN;\n            i++;\n        }\n\n        return number_formed * sign;\n    }\n\n    int myAtoi(string s) {\n        return CheckAllConditions(s);\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"string-to-integer-atoi","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2283}
